name: Chaos Crew 2

features.name: Random base-game drop
features.description: An instant mini-bonus that can trigger at random in the base game.

features.name: Cranky multiplier wilds
features.description: Cranky substitutes and applies multipliers to his wins.

review:
Punk duo Cranky and Sketchy are back – swingier, with new features and what was then Hacksaw's biggest max win. Nineteen lines.

A random drop can hit in the base game, giving you an instant taste of the old bonus: special symbols land and reveal values, then you're back to normal play. Cranky the cat is a wild carrying multipliers. Rated 5/5 for volatility, 20,000x max, top RTP 96.27% (versions down to 88.28%). Much more intense than the first.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.28% RTP
Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
